thread:
maria: Quick heads-up — I'm drafting the changelog entry and release note for the smart-routing rollout. Need: 1) concise feature blurb 2) example SDK snippet for fallback policy 3) known-issues bullet list + links. I'll paste a draft and we can iterate.

alex: Thanks! Can you include a short callout about model-variant fallback? PMs ask for a one-line impact summary for customers.

maria: Sure. Draft below — open to edits.

maria: ```
Smart routing: requests are routed by latency, cost, and region policies. Automatic model-variant fallback keeps traffic serving when capacity is constrained.
Impact: reduces 5xx risk during capacity spikes; may route to a quantized variant with slight perf delta.
Example (python):
from redwood import Client
client = Client()
resp = client.generate("hello", routing_policy={
  \"prioritize\": [\"latency\", \"cost\"],
  \"fallback\": {\"strategy\": \"model_variant\", \"allow_quantized\": True}
})
print(resp.text)
```

sam: Looks good. For known issues: add a note about embedding-index compatibility when fallback routes to models with different tokenizer behavior.

jess: Also FYI — the internal link we used for the model-compatibility matrix is 404 (docs/compat/index). I tried earlier. Can someone fix or point to the canonical doc? :grimacing:

maria: ack. @jess can you paste the broken link? I'll either update it or add a temp anchor.

jess: Here: https://redwood.dev/docs/compat/index — returns 404. Maybe the page moved under /guides/compat-matrix.

alex: If the canonical moved, let's link to the guides path and add a redirect note in the changelog "We link to the compatibility matrix (migrated to Guides)". Keeps readers unblocked.

maria: Good plan. I'll add: "See Compatibility matrix (Guides) — link to /guides/compat-matrix". Also adding an ops note: "If you hit model mismatch after a fallback, clear client-side cache and retry."

docs-bot: PR created: https://github.com/redwood/docs/pull/4421 by maria — draft changelog + snippet attached. CI: spellcheck + linkcheck queued.

sam: Can one of docs engineering do a quick linkcheck run locally? I can +1 once links are green.

maria: @sam if you can run linkcheck that'd be awesome. If not, I can kick off the job but might be later today.

jess: I'll temporarily update the compat link in the PR to the guides path so linkcheck passes. Follow-up: open a tiny redirect PR for the old path?

alex: Timeline: we'd like the changelog merged by EOD tomorrow so comms can schedule the announcement. Who can review copy?

sam: I can review for technical accuracy this afternoon (2–3pm PT).

maria: Cool — tagging @alex for signoff on the customer impact text.

alex: Will review after standup. If all good, I can approve by 11:30 PT.

maria: Final checklist I'm tracking here: [x] feature blurb, [x] SDK snippet, [ ] known-issues bullets (sam + jess to confirm), [ ] links validated, [ ] alex approval, [ ] merge + schedule.

jess: Quick nit: in the SDK snippet, can we change allow_quantized to "allow_quantized_variants" for clarity? Otherwise LGTM.

maria: done — updated snippet in PR.

docs-bot: Linkcheck finished — 1 warning (compat link redirected). Spellcheck passed.

sam: Verified embedding compat note. I added one sentence about tokenizer differences in the known-issues section.

maria: Thanks everyone. If there are no other blockers I'll merge after alex signs off. I'll also add the redirect PR for the old compat path so the permalink stays stable.

alex: Approved. :thumbsup:

maria: Merged and scheduled for tomorrow AM publish. Posting copy in #marketing after release note goes live.

jess: Great job — saved a dev a support ticket already. :tada:
